name: contentful-lib-helpers
description: Helpers for Contentful's Content Management API
author: Atida <hello@atida.com>

scripts.lint: eslint index.js lib test scripts eslint.config.js
scripts.lint-fix: eslint index.js lib test scripts eslint.config.js --fix
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.js lib test scripts eslint.config.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && node scripts/check-package.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm audit --audit-level=low && node scripts/check-package.js --release
